scope: static target utility; not dynamic trajectory privacy
mechanism: original preempt/sanitizer.py continuous-index discrete exponential PMF; vectorized inverse CDF
MOpt_extension: same original exact solver; end-to-end partial derivatives at held-out population mean, finite-difference checked at two scales. New target differentiation is an extension, not out-of-box code support.
domains: per-task min/max of one public released-Demo observation per patient; includes test values as public benchmark domain, reference mean excludes test patients
MELD_scope: lab function at contemporaneous measurements, dialysis fixed absent; no first-day extrema or full ICU policy recreation; smooth variants remove only rounding
SOFA_scope: sum of platelet, bilirubin and creatinine-only renal components; not full SOFA; no urine output
blood_gas: explicit ART specimen only; official FIO2 conversion; no predicted arterial classification
privacy: B index-distance metric composition, not standard whole-patient epsilon-DP
